On another sheet in cell A1

TandaCode ECCode LeaveAmount
AU01 1
AU223 223
AU3 3
AU224 224
AU6 6

Make tables from the data with the names

  • TimeHrsConversion
  • timehrsconversion_table

Place the below code into the TimeHrsConversion sheet's Code Sheet. (Right click sheet name and select View Code.
Paste the following sub into the sheet

Sub Replacer()
Dim TimeHrs As ListObject, Conv As ListObject
Set TimeHrs = Worksheets("TimeHrsConversion").ListObjects("TimeHrs")
Set Conv = Worksheets("timehrsconversion_table").ListObjects("Conv")
For i = 1 To TimeHrs.DataBodyRange.Rows.Count
    found = Application.VLookup(TimeHrs.DataBodyRange(i, 3), Union(Conv.Range.Columns(2), Conv.Range.Columns(3)), 2, False)
If TypeName(found) = "Error" Then

Else
    TimeHrs.DataBodyRange(i, "I") = found
    TimeHrs.DataBodyRange(i, "J") = found
End If
Next i

End Sub

The Sub use the Vlookup (compatible for older versions) to find the ECCode and if found then set the values of columns I andJ to the value in LeaveAmount column.

Q: Install swipl and access it from Terminal (Mac) A:

Install swipl

Use a search engine to find the Homebrew (or other) Terminal installation command for your platform and follow the instructions to install it. Then, search for the Terminal command to install SWI-Prolog using Homebrew and follow the instructions to install it. Alternatively, download and install SWI-Prolog for your machine at https://www.swi-prolog.org/build/ (SWI-Prolog).

Access swipl from Terminal (Mac)

In Terminal settings (Mac), make Bash the default shell:

/bin/bash

or:

chsh -s /bin/bash

In Terminal, edit the text file `~/.bashrc` using the text editor Nano:

nano ~/.bashrc

Add the following to the file ~/.bashrc:

export PATH="$PATH:/opt/homebrew/bin/

Check if `usr/local/bin` exists

ls -ld /usr/local/bin

Create the directory if missing

sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/bin

Link to swipl in Terminal

sudo ln -s /opt/homebrew/bin/swipl /usr/local/bin/swipl
